title: Interview with the first Neuralink patient
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Interview with the first Neuralink patient, about 2024-2025 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: No. I I interviewed the the guy that got the first one.

plain: Jay Anderson, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2025, says he interviewed the first person to receive a Neuralink, a brain implant made by the company of that name, a man named Noland Arbaugh. He mentions it around 2024 or 2025, in a talk that touches on technology being placed inside human bodies.
